cs.label: [section] Cíl předmětu a studijní výstupy:
cs.content: Seznámit studenty s problematikou extenzivního ovocnářství, možnostmi využití pro hospodářské a mimoprodukční účely, zejména v oblasti tvorby krajiny či v územích se zvláštním režimem hospodaření. Součástí je také úvod do pomologická determinace odrůd, zakládání a následné údržby výsadeb, včetně revitalizace starých ovocných stromů.

Kombinovaná forma: - minimálně 50% účast ve výuce; - vypracování projektu na zadané téma; - zápočet - test (minimální úspěšnost 80%); - zkouška - ústní forma - zkouška trvá cca 30 minut a student při ní odpovídá na tři otázky z tematických okruhů: 1. obecná část, 2. agrotechnika extenzivních výsadeb, 3. pomologie - využití starých odrůd.

en.label: b.

en.label: c.

en.label: b.

en.label: c.

en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: To acquaint students with extensive forms of fruit trees, their economic and non-productive significance, with respect of their utilization in landscape architecture and in the areas with special regime of management. Practical pomological determination of obsolete varieties and landraces, establishment of standard orchards and their subsequent maintenance.

en.label: [section] Course content:
en.content: 1.Introduction (allowance 0/0) a.Economic and non-productive function of fruit trees, old varieties and landraces. The origin of the fruit species, gene centers.b.Botanical and horticultural classification of fruit species, anatomical and morphological characteristics, ecological requirements.c.Importance of fruit trees in landscape, preservation of endangered and disappearing varieties, growing in marginal areas.2.Nursery production and planting of extensive orchards. (allowance 0/0) a.Propagation and growing of nursery plantsb.Planting of extensive orchards (principles and agro-technology)3.Growth and development of fruit trees (allowance 0/0) a.Whole life cycle (age periods), phenological stages.b.The importance and methods of pruning: educational pruning of young trees, maintenance pruning, rejuvenating pruning of old trees.c.Agrotechnical principles in extensive plantations, maintenance of old plantations, pests and diseases management of fruit trees.4.General pomology - distinguishing characters of fruit species and varieties (morphological characteristics, habit of tree canopy, external and internal characteristics of fruits). (allowance 0/0) a.Particular pomology of apples, pears, plums, prunes, sweet cherries and sour cherries.b.Particular pomology of apples, pears, plums, prunes, sweet cherries and sour cherries.c.Less common fruit species - their importance, growing requirements and possibilities of utilization.

en.label: [section] Assessment methods:
en.content: Ful-time form: - 100% participation in seminars; - development of a project on a given topic; - credit - test (minimum success rate 80%); - exam - oral form - the exam lasts about 30 minutes and during it the student answers three questions from thematic areas: 1. general part, 2. agrotechnics of extensive plantings, 3. pomology - use of old varieties. Part-time form: - at least 50% participation in classes; - development of a project on a given topic; - credit - test (minimum success rate 80%); - exam - oral form - the exam lasts about 30 minutes and during it the student answers three questions from thematic areas: 1. general part, 2. agrotechnics of extensive plantings, 3. pomology - use of old varieties.
